status: PROPOSED; no oracle is written, run or independent; authored_by is intentionally null

oracles.objective: No test places a frozen-table-divergent or Cf/Cs/Co/Cn token (TU-D*, TU-012/014/015/016) in allowed_institutions or allowed_authority_domains; every token vector and every validate_effective_payload refusal targets allowed_actions. A per-set shortcut (or a different token rule for the last two keys) would not be detected.
oracles.independence_note: Extend the existing 38 token_unicode vectors (already cross-checked by Node) to a per-member axis (5 members x 38). Independent of Registry code if the expected values come from the vector file.

oracles.objective: Two independent validators encode the same rules (v2_f1ab._list_ok and v2_policy_identity.validate_effective_payload, plus normalize_caller). No differential test runs them against each other over a shared corpus for the two sets; vectors only vary actions/units.
oracles.independence_note: Differential between two Registry code paths is weak independence; pair with the Node recomputation or a Runtime/CP implementation of the vectors.

oracles.objective: Decision-level negative coverage for the two sets is a single case (pop allowed_institutions -> validator field_missing). No decision-level (verify_and_decide_v2) test for unsorted, duplicate, token-invalid, oversize or wrong-type lists in either set, and none for allowed_authority_domains at all. At decision level the typed code is always collapsed to composition_record_invalid (decision.py 89-95 and 101-103; verify.py 412-415, 587-588), so the failing set is not identifiable.
oracles.independence_note: Per-set mutation table at validate_record_text_v2 + verify_and_decide_v2; expected codes are contract-derived, not read from code.

oracles.objective: Contract section 2 / Amendment 1 5.1(3) describe the token rule as 'no control, separator or * characters'; the code and spec 6.1 (N-13) additionally exclude format (Cf), surrogate, private-use and every code point unassigned in Unicode 15.1.0. The frozen contract text does not mention the table.
oracles.independence_note: Publish the table-derived expectations as the oracle for Runtime/CP; contract text is not a sufficient independent source.

oracles.objective: 128-character acceptance boundary and str-subclass/list-subclass rejection are asserted on allowed_actions only.

oracles.objective: No test where the registry set for allowed_institutions/allowed_authority_domains is a strict superset of the caller set at composer level (except one institutions case), and no property/exhaustive grid for either set (grid is units only).

oracles.objective: G0 worker A claim REFUTED at composer level and VERIFIED at decision/vector level: composer deny-all covers all five keys (32 combinations), but decision-level deny-all (V1A-03) and the single-dimension vectors (EP-011/012) are allowed_units only. oracles.objective: (c) No vector or test crosses scope.institution / scope.authority_domain with the payload sets. oracles.objective: Activation/selection is Registry-external (kit only). oracles.objective: No executable Registry-side oracle for effect-time containment of the two sets. oracles.objective: machine-readable ld02-outcome-map.json (vetted proposal, not ratified) still classifies selection_scope_mismatch and 23 other codes HOLD, and its `applied` entry says 'F1a sets only'; the ADR (line 131) flips only selection_epoch_stale and selection_withdrawn to REFUSE. oracles.objective: In the optional-refusal path decision._plain_refusal normalises the caller with the f1a three-key normaliser (decision.py:57); for a five-key caller that returns None and the raw caller object is returned as `effective` (line 58). oracles.objective: REFUSE vs HOLD classification of a wrong-institution/domain outcome is inconsistent across documents: map HOLD for selection_scope_mismatch; REFUSE for policy_identity_mismatch (Amend 1, 3, 4); kit REFUSE for guard mismatches. oracles.objective: No differential/equivalence oracle between compose_f1ab effective sets and LocalExecutionPolicy.check for the two sets. oracles.objective: Three different caller validators exist: normalize_caller (lenient: sets/tuples, unsorted, duplicates collapsed, frozen-table), validate_effective_payload role 'caller' (strict sorted/duplicate-free lists), and LocalExecutionPolicy.__post_init__ (any non-empty str incl. No contract text or vector says that a record activated for the authorized institution may carry allowed_institutions that exclude (or include) that institution, i.e. the same unspecified relation as M1-E-12 seen from the pin side. Pin refusals and containment refusals share the code policy_identity_mismatch and differ only by an unspecified cause string.

oracles.objective: Amendment 4 is DRAFT and Amendment 3 explicitly states it is not evidence F-01 is closed; any M1 closure claim cannot rely on Registry contract tests, which pin text only.

No test pins either reading, e.g. a record whose allowed_institutions excludes the scope institution.
